name: Elastic-Cache
tagline: Tracked-token windows with per-layer attention-similarity reset and confidence-thresholded one-token transfer.
pseudocode:
1. block_schedule: window_length=16, no warmup forward.
2. query_plan: step 0 → full sequence; later steps → tracked window only, plus current masked block.
3. cache_refresh_plan: feature cache OFF, refresh every step, kv_update = tracked-window layer reset.
4. layer_reset: triggered by attention-similarity ($\gamma{=}0.9$) — refresh layer KV when probe similarity drops.
5. attention_probe_plan: request attention weights, track top-1 token.
6. token_transfer: confidence_threshold ≥ $0.9$, one token per step in masked window.
diff_from_baseline: Elastic-Cache style policy: maintains a small tracked-token window and uses attention-similarity to trigger per-layer KV resets, committing one high-confidence token per step.

name: Vanilla (Uncached)
tagline: No-cache control: full-sequence LLaDA forward at every denoising step, default low-confidence token transfer.
pseudocode:
1. block_schedule: workload defaults, no warmup forward.
2. query_plan: query_scope = full_sequence every step, no tracked positions.
3. cache_refresh_plan: feature cache OFF, prompt and gen refresh interval = 1, kv_update = full_refresh.
4. attention_probe_plan: do not request attention weights.
5. token_transfer: low_confidence within current block, num_transfer = workload default, force ≥ 1 token.
6. after_step: cache_state unchanged.
diff_from_baseline: Reference uncached LLaDA-8B-Instruct decoding — pays full forward cost each step; serves as the quality upper-bound / cache lower-bound.

name: d2Cache
tagline: Active-query rows with attention-rollout top-up; full-sequence pass on the first step in each block, then only active rows.
pseudocode:
1. block_schedule: gen-length-sized blocks, num_steps = gen_length, no warmup forward.
2. query_plan: step_in_block 0 → full_sequence; later → active_query_rows from cache_state.
3. cache_refresh_plan: feature cache OFF, row_selector = certainty + density + attention rollout, kv_update = active_q_mask.
4. attention_probe_plan: rollout_p = $0.1$, current_k = $32$, σ = $10.0$.
5. token_transfer: low_confidence within current block, force ≥ 1 token.
6. after_step: cache_state unchanged.
diff_from_baseline: d2Cache-style policy: select an active query mask using certainty, density, and attention rollout; only those rows are recomputed beyond the first step.

name: dLLM-Cache
tagline: Interval-based feature cache with low-similarity row refresh; per-workload (prompt_int, gen_int, transfer_ratio) presets.
pseudocode:
1. presets: math (50,7,0.25), humaneval (50,8,0.25), lm_eval (50,3,0.25); else (50,4,0.25).
2. block_schedule: workload defaults, no warmup forward.
3. query_plan: full_sequence every step, no tracked positions.
4. cache_refresh_plan: feature cache ON, prompt/gen refresh intervals from preset, transfer_ratio = $0.25$, row_selector = lowest_value_feature_similarity, kv_update = scatter_refresh.
5. attention_probe_plan: no attention weights needed.
6. token_transfer: low_confidence within current block, force ≥ 1 token.
diff_from_baseline: Liu et al., dLLM-Cache (2025). Interval feature reuse for diffusion LMs: refresh prompt KV rarely, refresh generation KV every few steps, and scatter-refresh rows whose features drift the most.
